## West Bengal Statutory Minimum Wages & Payroll Ground Truth
- **Gazette Cycle:** July 2026 – December 2026 (Semi-annual VDA revision every January & July)
- **Zone A (All Municipal Corporations, Municipalities, Dankuni, Salt Lake, New Town, Industrial & Development Authorities):**
  - Unskilled: ₹10,558/month (₹406/day)
  - Semi-Skilled: ₹11,615/month (₹447/day)
  - Skilled: ₹12,777/month (₹491/day)
  - Highly Skilled: ₹14,054/month (₹541/day)
- **Zone B (Non-Municipal Rural Gram Panchayat Industrial Pockets):**
  - Unskilled: ₹9,760/month (₹375/day)
  - Semi-Skilled: ₹10,733/month (₹413/day)
  - Skilled: ₹11,807/month (₹454/day)
  - Highly Skilled: ₹12,990/month (₹500/day)
- **Mandatory Statutory Employer Overheads:** EPF 13.00% (12% + 0.5% EDLI + 0.5% Admin), ESIC 3.25%, Statutory Bonus 8.33%, WB Labour Welfare Fund (Employee ₹NaN / Employer ₹NaN half-yearly).

## Complete 26-Vertical Service Directory (7 B2B Pillars)
- [Security Guard Services](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/services/security-guard): Professional PSARA-licensed security guard deployment for corporate, industrial, and government establishments. (PSARA security guard, factory gatekeeper, time-office guard, warehouse weighbridge guard)
- [Armed Guard Services](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/services/armed-guard): Licensed armed security personnel for banks, jewelry stores, high-value asset protection and cash-in-transit.

- [Fire Fighting & Safety Services](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/services/fire-fighting): Trained fire fighting teams, fire safety equipment management, mock drills, and emergency response planning.
- [Event Security Services](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/services/event-security): Crowd management, access control, and event-specific security for corporate events, exhibitions, and public gatherings.
- [Industrial Security Services](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/services/industrial-security): Specialized security for factories, power plants, oil & gas facilities, and other industrial establishments.

## 8 Live Industrial Corridors
- [Bhubaneswar – Kalinga Nagar Industrial & IT Corridor (Odisha)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/corridors/bhubaneswar): Advance Corporate Security delivers PSARA-compliant enterprise guarding, automated gate logistics, and integrated facility management across Bhubaneswar's Infocity tech cluster, Chandaka, Khordha Industrial Park, and the heavy metallurgy corridor connecting to Kalinga Nagar and Paradip Port.
- [Jamshedpur – Adityapur Heavy Engineering & Auto Ancillary Corridor (Jharkhand)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/corridors/jamshedpur): Specialized heavy engineering security, scrap theft deterrence, and statutory manpower solutions for the Adityapur Industrial Area (AIADA), Gamharia auto cluster, and the greater Jamshedpur industrial ecosystem.
- [Ranchi – Ramgarh Mining, Heavy Engineering & Institutional Hub (Jharkhand)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/corridors/ranchi): Advance Corporate Security provides comprehensive physical guarding, access control, and facility soft services across Ranchi's institutional zones, Tupudana, Namkum, Tatisilwai electrical manufacturing cluster, and the Ramgarh-Patratu coal-mining corridor.
- [Guwahati – Amingaon Northeast Logistics & FMCG Gateway (Assam)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/corridors/guwahati): Enterprise security guarding, inland container depot (ICD) access control, and supply chain loss prevention across Guwahati's Amingaon logistics corridor, Palashbari, and Chaygaon FMCG manufacturing hubs.
- [Dankuni – Hooghly Multi-Modal Logistics & NH-19/NH-16 Corridor (West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/corridors/dankuni-hooghly-industrial-belt): Dedicated B2B blue-collar manpower supply, container loading/unloading (Hamali/Mutia) gangs, industrial electricians, weighbridge shrinkage controllers, and PSARA guarding across Dankuni, Dhulagarh, Ranihati, Sankrail, Uluberia, and Singur along NH-19 and NH-16.
- [Haldia Port, Petrochemical & Coastal Industrial Belt (West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/corridors/haldia-petrochemical-port-industrial-zone): Specialized contract manpower, industrial plumbers and pipe fitters, HVAC/utility mechanics, cargo handling helpers, and PSARA fire-safety security across Haldia Dock Complex, Durgachak, Sutahata, Kolaghat Thermal belt, and Vidyasagar Industrial Park (Kharagpur).
- [Durgapur – Panagarh – Asansol Heavy Steel & Coal Belt (West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/corridors/durgapur-asansol-heavy-industrial-belt): High-volume factory helpers, karkhana workers, ITI welders/fitters, heavy machinery rigging crews, industrial electricians, and armed/unarmed plant security serving Durgapur, Asansol, Raniganj, Andal, Panagarh Industrial Park, Burdwan, Barjora, and Raghunathpur.
- [Kolkata IT, CBD & Commercial Support Corridor (Sector V – New Town – CBD) (West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/corridors/kolkata-it-data-center-corridor-sector-v-new-town): End-to-end Integrated Facility Management (IFM), commercial HVAC/chiller technicians, HT/LT electricians, commercial plumbers, mechanized housekeeping, office peon/pantry staff, corporate office shifting crews, and PSARA concierge security for Salt Lake Sector V, New Town Rajarhat, Ecospace, Park Street, Camac Street, BBD Bagh, and Bantala IT/Leather zones.

## 8 Live Grade-A Industrial Parks & SEZs
- [ESR Uluberia Logistics Park (Uluberia Industrial Corridor, Howrah, West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/industrial-parks/esr-uluberia): ESR Uluberia is one of Eastern India's most modern Grade-A institutional logistics parks, strategically located along National Highway 16 in Howrah and directly benefiting from the West Bengal Investment Promotion Policy 2026 (WBIP 2026) logistics and industrial corridor incentives. Hosting multinational 3PL operators, e-commerce distribution centers, and national FMCG supply chains, ESR Uluberia demands rigorous single-vendor governance: rapid freight truck ingress, zero dock queueing, 100% weighbridge integrity, certified warehouse loading/unloading & Hamali manpower, and absolute alignment with West Bengal Zone A statutory labor wages.
- [SFA Logistics & Industrial Park, Dankuni (Dankuni Multi-Modal Logistics Belt, Hooghly, West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/industrial-parks/sfa-dankuni): SFA Logistics & Industrial Park is situated at the epicenter of Eastern India's rail-and-road freight convergence in Dankuni, Hooghly, within the priority expansion belt of the West Bengal Investment Promotion Policy 2026 (WBIP 2026). Located in immediate proximity to the Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor (EDFC) terminus and National Highway 19, this hub processes massive volumes of consumer electronics, retail apparel, and industrial machinery. ACS delivers integrated single-vendor 24/7 gate security, computerized weighbridge management, synchronized RFID perimeter tours, and statutory warehouse pickers, loaders, and electrical/MEP maintenance teams.
- [Transindia Logistics Park, Dankuni (Delhi Road Axis, Dankuni, Hooghly, West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/industrial-parks/transindia-dankuni): Transindia Logistics Park (developed by Allcargo Group) is an institutional Grade-A distribution hub on the Delhi Road corridor in Dankuni. Housing world-class fulfilment operations for multinational retail, automotive spare parts, and pharmaceuticals, this 50+ acre park requires comprehensive perimeter security, synchronized guard touring, advanced CCTV surveillance monitoring, and absolute statutory cleanliness.
- [Panagarh Industrial Park (WBIDC) (Panagarh, Kanksa, Paschim Bardhaman, West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/industrial-parks/panagarh-industrial-park): Spanning 1,445 acres directly along National Highway 19 (old NH-2) in Paschim Bardhaman, WBIDC's Panagarh Industrial Park hosts anchor fertilizer, chemical, engineering, and textile installations near Kazi Nazrul Islam Airport (Andal). ACS provides CLRA-licensed factory floor helpers, ITI welders and fitters, HT/LT electricians, heavy rigging labor, and 24/7 anti-pilferage gate guarding.
- [Vidyasagar Industrial Park, Kharagpur (WBIDC) (Kharagpur, Paschim Medinipur, West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/industrial-parks/vidyasagar-industrial-park): Strategically developed across 1,166 acres along NH-16 (old NH-6) just 60 km from Haldia Port, WBIDC's Vidyasagar Industrial Park hosts earthmoving machinery giants, auto-ancillaries, and heavy engineering plants. ACS deploys CNC/lathe helpers, ITI welders, heavy shifting crews, industrial plumbers, and PSARA security forces.
- [Bantala Kolkata Leather Complex (KLC) (Bantala, South 24 Parganas / East Kolkata, West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/industrial-parks/bantala-leather-complex): Asia's largest integrated leather complex across 1,150 acres on the Basanti Highway corridor east of EM Bypass, Bantala houses hundreds of export-oriented tanneries, footwear manufacturing units, effluent treatment plants (CETPs), and emerging IT parks. ACS supplies bulk production helpers, packing/container loading teams, ETP plumbing/mechanical technicians, and 24/7 export gate security.
- [Falta Special Economic Zone (FSEZ) (Falta, Sector II–IV, South 24 Parganas, West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/industrial-parks/falta-sez): Located along the Hooghly Riverfront in South 24 Parganas, Falta SEZ houses leading export-oriented units manufacturing engineering products, food & agro-commodities, apparel, plastics, and pharmaceuticals. Operating inside a Customs-bonded zone requires police-cleared contract personnel, seamless container loading/stuffing labor, HVAC/MEP upkeep, and strict SEZ pass accountability.
- [Barjora Industrial Park (WBIDC) (Barjora, Bankura District (Durgapur Link Highway), West Bengal)](https://advancecorporatesecurity.com/industrial-parks/barjora-industrial-park): Located just south of the Damodar River opposite Durgapur, Barjora Industrial Park is Bankura's flagship industrial cluster, anchored by ferro-alloy units, sponge iron plants, rolling mills, polymer factories, and logistics yards. ACS extends Durgapur-backed rapid deployment to supply furnace helpers, ITI fitters/electricians, weighbridge auditors, and armed/unarmed guards.

### Employer Cost Floor Reference (Per Head Monthly, Zone A vs Zone B)
- **unskilled:** Zone A Base ₹NaN -> Floor CTC ₹NaN/mo | Zone B Base ₹NaN -> Floor CTC ₹NaN/mo (incl. EPF 13%, ESIC 3.25%, Bonus 8.33%)
- **semiSkilled:** Zone A Base ₹NaN -> Floor CTC ₹NaN/mo | Zone B Base ₹NaN -> Floor CTC ₹NaN/mo (incl. EPF 13%, ESIC 3.25%, Bonus 8.33%)
- **skilled:** Zone A Base ₹NaN -> Floor CTC ₹NaN/mo | Zone B Base ₹NaN -> Floor CTC ₹NaN/mo (incl. EPF 13%, ESIC 3.25%, Bonus 8.33%)
- **highlySkilled:** Zone A Base ₹NaN -> Floor CTC ₹NaN/mo | Zone B Base ₹NaN -> Floor CTC ₹NaN/mo (incl. EPF 13%, ESIC 3.25%, Bonus 8.33%)

### B2B Procurement & MSME Vernacular Glossary
- **Hamali / Mutia Mazdoor:** Manual truck loading, container stuffing/destuffing, godown bag stacking & railway rake handling crews (`/services/loading-unloading-labour`).
- **Karkhana Mazdoor / General Helper:** Unskilled/semi-skilled production line feeders, foundry helpers, bottling/sorting/packaging workers (`/services/industrial-factory-workers`).
- **HT/LT Panel Wireman & DG Operator:** WB-licensed 415V/11kV industrial shift electricians and diesel generator operators (`/services/industrial-electrician-contractors`).
- **STP / WTP / Boiler Utility Staff:** Commercial pipeline fitters, effluent/sewage treatment plant operators, and industrial utilities (`/services/commercial-plumbing-contractors`).
- **CLRA / EPF Sec 7A Immunity:** Contract Labour license + verifiable monthly ECR challans & TRRN receipts protecting principal employers from vicarious liability (`/services/payroll-management`).
